explanation: This page introduces the Central Dogma of Biology, which describes the flow of genetic information within a biological system, typically summarized as DNA to RNA to Protein.

questions.q: What general molecular pathway does the Central Dogma of Biology describe?
opts: The flow of genetic information from DNA to RNA to protein
The pathway of glucose breakdown in cellular respiration
The steps of active transport across the cell membrane
The stages of the cell cycle and mitosis
questions.exp: Option A is correct because the Central Dogma describes the pathway of genetic information flow (typically DNA -> RNA -> protein). The other options describe cellular respiration, membrane transport, and cell cycle division, which are not the Central Dogma.
